theme: Light mode default (High-Contrast SaaS / Authority & Trust). Clean, minimalist, white/slate backgrounds with vibrant AI accents.

rules.headings: Use 'Outfit' (font-sans). Tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). Max size text-5xl/6xl for hero. Do NOT use Inter.
rules.body: Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (font-sans). Leading-relaxed for readability.

rules.neutral_tint: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Always use Slate (blue-tinted greys).
rules.ai_elements: Use the AI Accent (#4F46E5 - Indigo 600) strictly for AI actions, AI recommendations, and the AI Export Manager. Do not use it for generic primary buttons unless they trigger AI.
rules.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA 3:1 minimum contrast. Buttons must have clear hover states (lighter hue of active state).

layouts.dashboard: Collapsible left sidebar for navigation. Main content uses a strict Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6).
layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. 24px gutters standard.
layouts.kanban: Horizontal scrollable flex container with fixed-width columns (w-80 or w-96). Cards within columns stack vertically with gap-3.
layouts.marketing: Phi-proportioned sections. No generic 'Bootstrap' columns. Use aggressive asymmetry and generous whitespace (py-24 to py-32).

visual_enhancers.cards: Flat solid surfaces. 1px border-slate-200, bg-white, shadow-sm. Hover: shadow-md, border-slate-300, -translate-y-[2px] transition-all.
visual_enhancers.ai_surfaces: The 'Tracing Beam' or subtle glowing inner border (box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #4F46E5, 0 0 20px rgba(79,70,229,0.1)).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky headers or floating AI Export Manager. bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200/50.
visual_enhancers.data_density: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look) for the Quote Builder and Export Pack tables. Visible skeleton grid with border-collapse.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or smooth (rounded-lg). Primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800. AI Action: bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(79,70,229,0.3)].
components.inputs: Clean, rounded-md, border-slate-300 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500. Large text areas for the Inbox.
components.badges: Polished 'COMING SOON' badges in the sidebar. Small, rounded-full, bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200 text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5.
components.charts: Recharts. No grid lines. Smooth curves (type='monotone'). Custom tooltip with glassmorphism.
components.icons: lucide-react (stroke-width 1.5 for a lighter, premium feel).

motion.rules: Subtle, professional animations. No bounce effects.
motion.interactions: Hover states on all clickable elements. Framer Motion for layout transitions.
motion.ai_processing: Shimmer effects (skeleton loaders) and subtle pulsing glows when the AI is analyzing the inquiry or generating the export pack.
motion.page_transitions: Fade and slight slide-up (y: 10, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1).

avatars.description: Confident business professional (use for Buyer profile)
Smiling woman in formal suit (use for Buyer profile)

backgrounds.description: Light, subtle blue/white abstract background (use at very low opacity 0.05 for landing page hero background)

accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings on all inputs/buttons (focus-visible:ring-2).
accessibility.contrast: Text over backgrounds must exceed 4.5:1. Never use gray-on-gray for essential info.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='analyze-inquiry-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Start by importing the fonts (Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans) in index.css.
2. Implement a unified layout shell for the dashboard with a collapsible left sidebar containing 'CORE' and 'EXPANSION' sections.
3. Build the Landing Page first to set the brand tone. Use aggressive spacing and a clean hero section.
4. For the Command Center, use a Bento Grid layout. The 'AI Action Center' should be visually distinct (e.g., subtle indigo border/glow).
5. The 'AI Buyer Inbox' must have a realistic text area and an 'Analyze Inquiry' button that triggers a loading state before revealing the Extracted Requirements.
6. Use Shadcn UI primitives but strip away default aesthetics to match the premium, flat, sharp-yet-rounded (0.5rem radius) B2B look.
7. Ensure the Deals Kanban uses a horizontal scrolling area and clearly displays 'Deal Health' scores.
8. Implement Recharts for the 'Revenue at Risk' chart with minimal UI (hide grid lines, use custom tooltips).
9. Use lucide-react icons throughout. Avoid cartoonish illustrations.
10. Ensure the app requires NO LOGIN and defaults to a Demo Workspace immediately as requested.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do NOT use dark colors as gradients. Stick to solid colors or extremely subtle meshes.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical or F-pattern alignments.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle shadows (shadow-sm, shadow-md).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties (opacity, transform, background-color).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in App.css.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder AI emoji characters (🤖🧠) for icons. Use proper lucide-react icons (e.g., Bot, Sparkles, Zap).
Missing categories/images = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Create new components that match the style.
